children: U.S. lemon and avocado grower reported fiscal Q3 revenue down yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company agreed to sell Windfall Farms property for $15 mln in all-cash deal
Limoneira expects fiscal 2026 fresh lemon volumes at the lower end of 4.0-4.5 mln cartons
Company raises fiscal 2026 avocado volume guidance to 7.0-7.25 mln pounds
Limoneira expects a monetization event tied to Colorado River water rights in fiscal 2026
BROKERAGE TRANSITION - Lower brokered lemon, orange and specialty citrus sales due to transition of citrus brokerage operations to Sunkist
HIGHER LEMON PRICES - Increased fresh lemon carton sales driven by higher prices
COST REDUCTIONS - Lower selling, general and administrative expenses mainly from reduced salaries and selling expenses related to Sunkist transition
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the fishing & farming peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Limoneira Co is $18.00, about 19.8% above its September 8 closing price of $15.03
The stock recently traded at 39 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 154 three months ago
